# Wagtail CMS

> Wagtail is a free, open source content management system written in Python and built on the Django web framework. It is released under the BSD-3-Clause license and developed as an open source project by Torchbox. Used by Google, NASA, MIT, NHS and Mozilla, among others.

Install with `pip install wagtail`.

## Start here
- [Get started](https://wagtail.org/get-started/): Install Wagtail and build a first site.
- [Documentation](https://docs.wagtail.org/): Official docs for developers and editors.
- [Documentation index for agents](https://docs.wagtail.org/llms.txt): Every docs page, each with a Markdown version.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wagtail/wagtail): Source code and issue tracker.

## About Wagtail
- [Features](https://wagtail.org/features/): What Wagtail offers editors and developers.
- [Wagtail AI](https://wagtail.org/wagtail-ai/): Optional AI features for content editing.
- [Headless CMS](https://wagtail.org/headless/): Using Wagtail as a headless CMS.
- [Packages](https://wagtail.org/packages/): Third-party packages that extend Wagtail.
- [Blog](https://wagtail.org/blog/): Release notes, community news and perspectives.
